description: List a deployed workflow's recent runs, newest first, read on demand from the user's own Cloudflare account. `source: history` (default) lists completed runs with an executionId, status and duration from the workflow's run log; it is empty until something has actually run. `source: instances` lists durable runs with an instanceId, including ones still queued, waiting or paused, and can filter by `status`. Pass the returned `cursor` back to get the next page. Open one run with get_run.

cursor.description: The cursor from the previous page, with the same source and order.

order.description: Only with source `history`. Default newest; oldest pages through all retained history.

source.description: `history` (default): the run log. `instances`: durable runs and their state.

status.description: Only with source `instances`: return runs in this state.

workflowId.description: The workflow's id, from list_workflows or create_workflow.

name: list_runs
title: List runs
